# Best waterproof Bluetooth speakers for the pool or beach

**My top pick: JBL Charge 6 (about $130-150).** It's IP68 (dust-tight and submersible), sounds powerful and detailed, and can charge your phone. What Hi-Fi named it best overall, and BestProducts did too. Battery claims vary by source: 20 hours (28 with Playtime Boost) per [What Hi-Fi](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart), and 28 hours max per [BestProducts](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/). What Hi-Fi lists it at $129.99 at Walmart and $149.95 at Amazon, so buy through the retailer links on those pages.

## Other picks by need

- **Floats and fills a pool party: JBL Boombox 4.** RTINGS' top waterproof pick. It floats, handles long immersion, and gets loud with over 40 hours of battery. It's big and pricey, and the sound is narrow, so it's best when you're in front of it. [RTINGS review with buy links](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth)
- **Even sound all around the pool: Ultimate Ears Epicboom.** IP67, floats, and has 360-degree sound. It was Tom's Guide's best overall and RTINGS' best mid-range pick. Battery is about 15 hours. [Tom's Guide picks with buy links](https://www.tomsguide.com/best-picks/best-waterproof-speakers)
- **Budget: Ultimate Ears Wonderboom 4 (about $65-80).** IP67, floats, and has 360-degree sound. Battery is 14 hours. [BestProducts listing](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/)
- **Small and easy to pack: JBL Grip ($100).** IP68, about 0.85 lb, and shaped like a can so it fits in a bag's bottle pocket. Battery is 12 hours. Good Housekeeping's best overall for the beach. [Good Housekeeping](https://www.goodhousekeeping.com/what-to-buy/a71783745/best-waterproof-speakers/)
- **Cheapest: JBL Go 5 (about $40).** IP67 and pocket-sized, but only 8 hours of battery. [What Hi-Fi](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart)
- **Loudest for a big crowd: Soundcore Boom 2 Plus.** 100 W, floats, IPX7, and up to 20 hours of battery with lights off. It's heavy at 3.8 kg and lists no dust rating, so keep it on a towel at the beach. It lists at $249.99, and that page shows code AFSC20 taking $49.99 off. I haven't verified the code. The link is an affiliate link. [Buy at Soundcore via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-boom-2-plus)

## Tips
- Look for IP67 or higher. For sandy beaches, the first digit should be 5 or 6 for dust protection.
- IP ratings don't cover salt or chlorine damage. Rinse the speaker with fresh water if the manual allows, and dry it fully before charging ([RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth)).
- Keep the charging port flap closed around water.

If you tell me your budget and whether you want something portable or a loud party speaker, I can narrow this to one pick.
